Here’s a complete, **no-fluff breakdown** of the **CAT exam (Common Admission Test)** — everything you need to know to take it seriously and prepare smart.

---

## 🧠 WHAT IS CAT?

**CAT (Common Admission Test)** is a **national-level MBA entrance exam** conducted by the **Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs)** on a **rotational basis**. It’s the gateway not just to the **20 IIMs**, but also to over **1,200 top B-schools** in India like:

- FMS Delhi  
- MDI Gurgaon  
- SPJIMR Mumbai  
- IMT Ghaziabad  
- IITs (for MBA)  
- NITIE (now IIM Mumbai)  
- and more

---

## 🗓️ EXAM DETAILS (CAT 2024 Format)

| Feature              | Details                                  |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------|
| **Conducting Body**  | IIMs (2024 by IIM Calcutta – expected)   |
| **Exam Date**        | Last Sunday of November (Tentative: Nov 24, 2024) |
| **Mode**             | Online (Computer-based)                  |
| **Duration**         | 120 minutes total (3 sections × 40 mins) |
| **Attempts per Year**| Once                                     |
| **Sections**         | 3 (see below)                            |

---

## 🧾 SECTIONS & SYLLABUS

### 1. 📘 Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC)
- Reading Comprehension (RCs) – 4 passages
- Para jumbles (PJ)
- Para summary
- Odd sentence out
- Sentence completion

### 2. 📊 Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning (DILR)
- Graphs, Tables, Charts
- Caselets, Games & Tournaments
- Arrangements, Puzzles, Logical Sets

### 3. ➕ Quantitative Ability (QA)
- Arithmetic: %age, Ratio, SI/CI, TSD, Time & Work
- Algebra: Equations, Inequalities, Logs, Functions
- Geometry & Mensuration
- Number Systems
- Modern Math (P&C, Probability, Sets)

📌 **No fixed syllabus** is issued officially — it’s pattern-based, from 10th–12th level mathematics and logical aptitude.

---

## 📝 EXAM PATTERN

| Section | Time | MCQs | TITA (non-MCQ) | Total Qs |
|---------|------|------|----------------|----------|
| VARC    | 40m  | ~21  | ~3–5           | ~24      |
| DILR    | 40m  | ~16  | ~4–6           | ~20      |
| QA      | 40m  | ~20  | ~4–6           | ~22      |
| **Total** | 120m | ~57 | ~12–18         | ~66      |

---

## 🎯 SCORING & MARKING SCHEME

- ✅ +3 marks for each correct answer  
- ❌ –1 mark for each incorrect **MCQ**  
- ⛔ **No negative marking** for **TITA (non-MCQs)**

Total score: Out of **198 marks**

---

## 📊 PERCENTILE & RANKING

Your score is converted to a **percentile** — it shows how many candidates you outperformed.

| Percentile | Estimated Raw Score |
|------------|---------------------|
| 99.9%ile   | ~105–115 marks      |
| 99%ile     | ~90–100 marks       |
| 95%ile     | ~70–80 marks        |
| 90%ile     | ~60–70 marks        |

---

## 🧾 ELIGIBILITY

- Bachelor's degree with **50% marks** (45% for SC/ST/PwD)
- Final-year students eligible (must provide proof)
- **No age limit**, **no stream restriction**

---

## 🎓 SELECTION PROCESS (After CAT)

Each IIM and B-school has its own process. Generally:

1. **Shortlist via CAT percentile**
2. **WAT (Written Ability Test)** – Essay writing
3. **PI (Personal Interview)**
4. Final merit list: CAT + Academics + Work Ex + Diversity

---

## 📅 IMPORTANT DATES (Tentative for 2024)

| Event                     | Date Range (Expected)      |
|---------------------------|----------------------------|
| Notification Release      | July 2024                  |
| Registration Starts       | August 2024                |
| Admit Card Download       | October 2024               |
| Exam Date                 | November 24, 2024 (Tent.)  |
| Result Declaration        | 1st week of January 2025   |

---

## 💸 APPLICATION FEES (CAT 2023 Reference)

- ₹2400 for General/EWS/OBC
- ₹1200 for SC/ST/PwD

---

## 📚 PREPARATION TIPS

- Start early: 6–9 months prep ideal
- Focus on basics: NCERTs for QA, daily RC reading
- Mock tests: Minimum 25 full-length + sectionals
- Use trusted resources: Arun Sharma, TIME, IMS, CL, etc.

---

## ✅ OFFICIAL WEBSITE

👉 [https://iimcat.ac.in](https://iimcat.ac.in)

---
